توافقت (form VI)
# تَوَافَقْتُ (tawāfaqtu) /ta.waː.faq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَافَقَ (tawāfaqa)
# تَوَافَقْتَ (tawāfaqta) /ta.waː.faq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَافَقَ (tawāfaqa)
# تَوَافَقْتِ (tawāfaqti) /ta.waː.faq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَافَقَ (tawāfaqa)
# تَوَافَقَتْ (tawāfaqat) /ta.waː.fa.qat/: third-person fem
